source_name: Wikimedia Wikibooks and Wikiversity explicit MediaWiki math tags

official_access.access_mode: Official per-wiki monthly compressed XML content exports with SHA256SUMS completion markers; no page-by-page scraping.
official_access.listing_rule: Select public production wikis from the official WikiId mapping whose hostname ends in .wikibooks.org or .wikiversity.org. Exclude betawikiversity because it is a cross-project incubation/coordination surface rather than a production language-edition learning corpus. For each selected wiki_id, choose a generation only after SHA256SUMS exists, acquire every listed XML.bz2 object outside Git, and verify sha256sum --check before extraction.

scope.projects: Production Wikibooks and Wikiversity language editions across Wikimedia
structures: functions, recurrences, inequalities, transformations, objectives, constraints and quantitative rules encoded through the Math extension
scope.original_representation: exact body of the explicit math tag plus raw matched tag and attributes from revision wikitext
scope.batching: one wiki_id plus one completed content-current export generation per source_snapshot/materialization batch
exclusions: betawikiversity is excluded from the production corpus
Redirect pages are excluded from the default learning-material lane
Non-main namespaces are excluded by default and can be enabled explicitly after a namespace-specific audit
Math-like text inside HTML comments, nowiki, pre, source, syntaxhighlight and code regions is excluded
{{#tag:math|...}} parser-function forms require a separate parser-aware lane
No prose-to-math reconstruction, OCR or translation is performed in the extracted stage

snapshot_policy.rule: For one selected Wikibooks or Wikiversity wiki_id, pin a completed mediawiki_content_current export generation by the presence of its official SHA256SUMS, verify every acquired object against that checksum surface, then compute a deterministic local SHA-256 inventory over the exact downloaded files. Use wikimedia-content-current:<wiki_id>:inventory-sha256:<digest> as source_snapshot. Do not mix wiki_ids or export generations in one materialization batch.

license_policy.scope: Wikibooks and Wikiversity text, with project-edition and imported-text caveats
license_policy.rule: Wikimedia's Terms of Use license contributor-owned text under CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL unless a Project edition or feature requires another free license; imported text can carry compatible-license and additional-attribution obligations. Preserve wiki_id, language, hostname, page title, page/revision identifiers, stable oldid URL and source snapshot on every occurrence. Before publication, fail closed for a page/project with an explicit incompatible or unresolved rights exception. Do not republish Wikimedia XML export bytes in the Atlas Internet Archive item; publish only permitted derived occurrence Parquets and deterministic manifests with applicable attribution/share-alike metadata.

adapter.input: one locally verified Wikibooks or Wikiversity mediawiki_content_current XML/XML.bz2 file or directory
validation: Every expression body is non-empty and appears explicitly inside a MediaWiki Math extension tag
wiki_id participates in source_document_id, source_locator and source_record_sha256 so page/revision IDs cannot collide across projects or languages
Revision/page identifiers and stable oldid URL are preserved when available
source_record_sha256 is independent of physical export-part packaging
No reconstruction, OCR, translation or parser-function expansion is claimed at extracted stage
